mapper.insert: /* QuoteMapper.insertQuote */ INSERT INTO QUOTE (SVC_REQ_SN, USR_SN, QUT_TTL, QUT_AMT, QUT_CN, QUT_STATUS_CD, QUT_REVISE_CNT, QUT_REG_ID, QUT_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{svcReqSn}, #{usrSn}, #{qutTtl}, #{qutAmt}, #{qutCn}, #{qutStatusCd}, 0, #{qutRegId}, #{qutUpdtId})
mapper.select: /* QuoteMapper.findMyQuotes */ SELECT q.QUT_SN, q.SVC_REQ_SN, sr.SVC_REQ_TTL, c.CAT_NM, sr.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, sr.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, hope.HOPE_DT, q.QUT_AMT, q.QUT_CN, q.QUT_TTL, q.QUT_STATUS_CD, q.QUT_REVISE_CNT, q.QUT_REG_DT, q.QUT_UPDT_DT FROM QUOTE q LEFT JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST sr ON sr.SVC_REQ_SN = q.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = sr.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.SVC_REQ_SN, MIN(STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS HOPE_DT FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' GROUP BY i.SVC_REQ_SN ) hope ON hope.SVC_REQ_SN = q.SVC_REQ_SN WHERE q.USR_SN = #{usrSn} ORDER BY q.QUT_REG_DT DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

/* QuoteMapper.findMyQuote */ SELECT q.QUT_SN, q.SVC_REQ_SN, sr.SVC_REQ_TTL, c.CAT_NM, sr.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, sr.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, hope.HOPE_DT, q.QUT_AMT, q.QUT_CN, q.QUT_TTL, q.QUT_STATUS_CD, q.QUT_REVISE_CNT, q.QUT_REG_DT, q.QUT_UPDT_DT FROM QUOTE q LEFT JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST sr ON sr.SVC_REQ_SN = q.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = sr.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.SVC_REQ_SN, MIN(STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS HOPE_DT FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' GROUP BY i.SVC_REQ_SN ) hope ON hope.SVC_REQ_SN = q.SVC_REQ_SN WHERE q.USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND q.QUT_SN = #{qutSn}

/* QuoteMapper.findMyQuoteSummary */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalQuoteCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN QUT_STATUS_CD IN ('QUTC0001', 'QUTC0002') THEN 1 END) AS activeQuoteCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN QUT_STATUS_CD = 'QUTC0004' THEN 1 END) AS selectedQuoteCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN QUT_STATUS_CD IN ('QUTC0003', 'QUTC0005') THEN 1 END) AS endedQuoteCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN QUT_STATUS_CD NOT IN ('QUTC0001', 'QUTC0002', 'QUTC0003', 'QUTC0004', 'QUTC0005') THEN 1 END) AS unsupportedQuoteCount FROM QUOTE WHERE USR_SN = #{usrSn}

/* QuoteMapper.findAdminQuoteListItems */ SELECT q.SVC_REQ_SN AS serviceRequestId, q.QUT_SN AS quoteId, q.USR_SN AS providerUserId, q.QUT_AMT AS amount, q.QUT_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, q.QUT_REVISE_CNT AS reviseCount, q.QUT_REG_DT AS submittedAt, q.QUT_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt FROM QUOTE q WHERE q.SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} ORDER BY q.QUT_REG_DT DESC, q.QUT_SN DESC

/* QuoteMapper.findMyActiveQuote */ SELECT q.QUT_SN, q.SVC_REQ_SN, sr.SVC_REQ_TTL, c.CAT_NM, sr.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, sr.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, hope.HOPE_DT, q.QUT_AMT, q.QUT_CN, q.QUT_TTL, q.QUT_STATUS_CD, q.QUT_REVISE_CNT, q.QUT_REG_DT, q.QUT_UPDT_DT FROM QUOTE q LEFT JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST sr ON sr.SVC_REQ_SN = q.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = sr.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.SVC_REQ_SN, MIN(STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS HOPE_DT FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' GROUP BY i.SVC_REQ_SN ) hope ON hope.SVC_REQ_SN = q.SVC_REQ_SN WHERE q.USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND q.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND q.QUT_STATUS_CD IN ('QUTC0001', 'QUTC0002') ORDER BY q.QUT_UPDT_DT DESC, q.QUT_SN DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* QuoteMapper.insertQuoteHistory */ INSERT INTO QUOTE_HISTORY (QUT_SN, QUT_HST_AMT, QUT_HST_CN, QUT_HST_REG_ID, QUT_HST_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{qutSn}, #{qutHstAmt}, #{qutHstCn}, #{qutHstRegId}, #{qutHstUpdtId})
mapper.delete: /* QuoteMapper.deleteQuotePhotosByQutSn */ DELETE FROM QUOTE_PHOTO WHERE QUT_SN = #{qutSn}
mapper.select: /* QuoteMapper.findQuoteAttachments */ SELECT qp.FL_SN AS flSn, f.FL_ORG_NM AS fileName FROM QUOTE_PHOTO qp JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = qp.FL_SN WHERE qp.QUT_SN = #{qutSn} AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY qp.SORT_NO ASC, qp.QUT_PHT_SN ASC

/* QuoteMapper.findQuotesBySvcReqSn */ SELECT q.QUT_SN, q.USR_SN AS PROVIDER_USR_SN, u.USR_NM AS PROVIDER_NM, q.QUT_AMT, q.QUT_CN, q.QUT_STATUS_CD, q.QUT_REVISE_CNT, q.QUT_REG_DT, q.QUT_UPDT_DT FROM QUOTE q JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = q.USR_SN WHERE q.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} ORDER BY q.QUT_REG_DT DESC
